# Native client build toolchain pin, owner-approved 2026-10-27 (security contract,
# "Owner-approved amendment, 2026-10-27 (second)", item 4; Stream B LOG D270/D301).
# rustc 1.94.1 (commit e408947bfd200af42db322daf0fadfe7e26d3bd1, 2026-03-25),
# cargo 1.94.1 (29ea6fb6a), LLVM 21.1.8, target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.
# rustup reads this file from the directory cargo runs in: build the client from
# tools/r1-cost-probe (cd tools/r1-cost-probe && cargo build --release --offline
# --locked -j 4 ... --bin devnet_spend), RUSTFLAGS as recorded, no target-cpu change.
[toolchain]
channel = "1.94.1"
targets = ["x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"]
profile = "minimal"

[workspace]
members = [
    "crates/aspis-core",
    "crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe",
    "crates/aspis-prover",
    "crates/aspis-statement",
    "programs/aspis-pool",
    "programs/aspis-registry",
    "programs/aspis-verifier",
    "programs/r1-cost-probe",
    "audit/poseidon-pair-probe/program",
    "xtask",
    # Extracted builder copies (D68.2): the shipped pair-forest trace writers.
    # Their src/lib.rs files are the pinned extraction inputs; keep them byte-identical.
    "docs/research/v8-r0-zk-20261009/refine/writers",
    "docs/research/v8-r0-zk-20261009/refine/blockwriters",
    "docs/research/v8-r0-zk-20261009/refine/poseidon",
]
# The research probes under docs/ are standalone crates with their own
# [workspace]; the R1 cost probe uses the z4 probe library only behind its
# `r1p-check` feature (LOG D38.3).
exclude = ["docs"]
resolver = "2"

[workspace.package]
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
version = "0.1.0"

[workspace.dependencies]
hkdf = "0.12.4"
hpke = { version = "=0.14.0", default-features = false, features = ["alloc", "chacha", "x25519"] }
aspis-core = { path = "crates/aspis-core" }
aspis-prover = { path = "crates/aspis-prover" }
aspis-statement = { path = "crates/aspis-statement" }
aspis-verifier = { path = "programs/aspis-verifier", default-features = false, features = ["no-entrypoint"] }
anyhow = "1.0.100"
base64 = "0.22.1"
bincode = "1.3.3"
borsh = { version = "=1.5.7", features = ["derive"] }
chrono = { version = "0.4.42", default-features = false, features = ["clock", "serde", "std"] }
chacha20poly1305 = { version = "=0.11.0", default-features = false, features = ["zeroize"] }
getrandom = "0.3.4"
reqwest = { version = "0.12.28", default-features = false, features = ["blocking", "json", "rustls-tls"] }
serde = { version = "1.0.228", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.145"
sha2 = "0.10.8"
solana-program = "2.3.0"
solana-loader-v3-interface = { version = "5.0.0", features = ["bincode"] }
solana-sdk = "2.3.0"
solana-system-interface = { version = "1.0.0", features = ["bincode"] }
zeroize = "1.8.1"
x25519-dalek = { version = "=3.0.0", default-features = false, features = ["zeroize"] }

# The extracted P_R1 checker and builders are modelled with checked arithmetic
# (an overflow is a failure, D57.1): keep overflow checks in optimized builds.
[profile.release.package.aspis-r1-cert-check]
overflow-checks = true

[profile.release.package.aspis-r1-cert-build]
overflow-checks = true

[package]
name = "aspis-pool"
edition.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
version.workspace = true
description = "Pool V1 authenticated Solana state-transition program"

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "lib"]

[features]
default = []
no-entrypoint = []
# Measurement-only entrypoint for the proof-carried pair afterstate.  Release
# builds do not enable this feature until the real merged 26-C1/3-C2 verifier emits
# the authenticated ASJA result.
pair-afterstate-evidence = []
pair-afterstate-profile = ["pair-afterstate-evidence"]
# Production-inactive account/PDA/checkpoint/deposit/terminal plumbing for the
# accepted eight-lane forest candidate. Release builds leave it disabled.
pair-forest-account-evidence = []
# Forward the already authenticated registry and entry through the verifier
# CPI so an audit-only verifier lane-invariant reader can independently root
# its capability in immutable selected-release configuration.
pair-forest-verifier-lane-invariant-audit = ["pair-forest-account-evidence"]
# R1 split verification uses a foreign read-only proof buffer and appends a
# separate verifier-owned checkpoint to the terminal account list. The default
# V7 sealed-proof account contract is unchanged.
r1-split-checkpoint = ["pair-forest-verifier-lane-invariant-audit"]
# Audit-only direct consumer for a canonical ASR8 already decoded and bound to
# the selected verifier return program. It avoids reconstructing ASF8 and
# re-encoding the same ASR8 bytes after the exact field checks.
pair-forest-direct-result-audit = ["pair-forest-account-evidence"]
# Instrumented local phase ledger. Logging changes total CU.
pair-forest-cu-profile-audit = ["pair-forest-account-evidence"]
pair-forest-history-page-invariant-audit = ["pair-forest-account-evidence"]
# Exact one-transaction eight-lane release-candidate path measured by the
# TxV1 combined harness.  This aggregate switch keeps the selected feature
# set reproducible while the named Rust-to-Lean/Aeneas release gates remain
# explicit; it is intentionally not part of `default`.
v7-pair-forest-one-tx-candidate = [
    "pair-forest-source-result-invariant-audit",
    "pair-forest-verifier-lane-invariant-audit",
    "pair-forest-direct-result-audit",
    "pair-forest-history-page-invariant-audit",
    "pair-forest-deposit-invariant-audit",
]
# Audit-only full 1,880-byte ASF8 top-level transport. It shares the exact
# account order, registry authentication, ASR8 validation, and settlement path
# with `pair-forest-account-evidence`.
pair-forest-full-asf8-audit = ["pair-forest-account-evidence"]
# Default-off local CU variants backed by the named inductive Pool-write
# invariant. They are not release features until Rust-to-Lean/Aeneas closure.
pair-forest-source-invariant-audit = ["pair-forest-account-evidence"]
pair-forest-source-result-invariant-audit = ["pair-forest-source-invariant-audit"]
# Deposit-only switch for the same inductive Pool-write invariant. It does not
# enable the terminal source/result features directly. Following sequential
# live CU evidence and persisted-state source/formal closure, it is included
# by the default-off V7 candidate aggregate while remaining absent from
# `default`.
pair-forest-deposit-invariant-audit = ["pair-forest-account-evidence"]

[dependencies]
aspis-core.workspace = true
aspis-statement = { workspace = true, features = ["pool-v1-kernel"] }
solana-program.workspace = true
solana-sdk-ids = "2.2.1"

[dev-dependencies]
sha2.workspace = true
